content:
**Top 5 UK universities in the 2024 Complete University Guide ranking – year of establishment**

| Rank | University | Year founded |
|------|------------|--------------|
| 1 | University of **Oxford** | 1096 |
| 2 | University of **Cambridge** | 1209 |
| 3 | **Imperial College London** | 1907 (originated as part of the Royal School of Mines, 1851, but became Imperial College in 1907) |
| 4 | **University College London (UCL)** | 1826 |
| 5 | University of **Edinburgh** | 1583 |

These dates are the official founding years of each institution, as listed in their respective histories and confirmed by the universities’ own archival records.
